description:
Find genes that are essential in a specific disease context.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_essentiality_screens — one record = one DepMap CRISPR screen result of one gene in one cell line (grouped by tissue).
Key: id, geneEssentiality[].depMapEssentiality[].tissueId, geneEssentiality[].depMapEssentiality[].screens[].depmapId.
Results: one row = one item (one DepMap CRISPR screen result of one gene in one cell line (grouped by tissue)); `_vbt.total` counts items; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.cell_line` counts cell_lines.
Cutoff: dependency = geneEffect ≤ -0.5, inclusive.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. DepMap CRISPR screens of cancer cell lines only; a missing gene or line means not screened.
